entries.339c2e17d766782c: A sales category covering commercial vacuum cleaners, automatic floor scrubbers, cleaning robots, road sweepers, polishers, wood floor sanding equipment, and cleaning chemical supplies. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥13,983 million (down 2.0% from the previous fiscal year). The securities report states that in Japan, cleaning equipment of Amano Corporation on a standalone basis decreased by ¥14 million in sales and maintenance and supplies increased by ¥67 million, and that overseas, Amano Pioneer Eclipse Corp. in North America had lower sales.

entries.55a8e43387116e8c: This is the sales category for equipment and systems that handle parking lot fee settlement and entry/exit management, and for contracted parking lot operation, and it is the largest category within the Time Information Systems Business. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥93,042 million (down 0.4% from the previous fiscal year). The annual securities report states that in Japan, revenue from parking equipment and from maintenance and supplies decreased because of a reaction to the special demand for the new banknotes in the previous fiscal year, while the contracted operation business of Amano Management Service Co., Ltd. was solid, with the number of contracted parking spaces up 33,000 (4.2%) from the end of the previous fiscal year; overseas, revenue increased at Amano McGann, Inc. in North America and in the contracted operation business in South Korea.

entries.6a3562085d7083aa: This is the sales category for systems such as time and attendance management, personnel management and payroll management, system time recorders, and cloud services. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥41,631 million (up 4.2% from the previous fiscal year). The annual securities report states that in Japan, against a backdrop of demand for system renewals at client companies, Amano's standalone software revenue increased by ¥1,132 million (up 8.8%) through renewal proposals, and Amano Business Solutions Co., Ltd., which offers cloud services, was also solid; overseas, revenue increased at Horoquartz S.A. in France, while revenue decreased at Accu-Time Systems, Inc. in North America.

entries.7ee34c54ce9b6685: A sales category covering time recorders and similar products. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,251 million (down 7.6% from the previous year). The securities report states that in Japan sales of both standard models and time recorders with attendance management software decreased, and overseas sales decreased in Europe, North America and Asia.
entries.8c88dae8d11ceaed: A sales category covering dust collectors and dust collection equipment, powder and granular material pneumatic conveying systems, high-temperature hazardous gas removal systems, deodorization systems and similar products. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥25,557 million (up 1.0% from the previous year). The securities report states that in Japan, Amano's standalone large systems rose ¥1,180 million (up 15.0%) and maintenance and supplies also rose, while general-purpose units fell ¥431 million (down 6.0%), and overseas sales decreased in both North America and Asia.
entries.9664ca79b2505415: This reportable segment makes and sells dust collectors and dust collection equipment that clean the air in factories and other sites, and cleaning equipment that cleans floors and other surfaces. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥39,541 million (down 0.1% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥4,918 million. The company manufactures the products and sells them in Japan, and also exports them to some overseas regions. Amano Musashi Denki Co., Ltd. manufactures cleaning equipment; Amano Pioneer Eclipse Corp. (United States) manufactures cleaning equipment, floor maintenance chemical products and dust collectors; Amano Time & Air Thailand Co.,Ltd. manufactures dust collectors and dust collection equipment; and Kankyo Eisei Kenkyujo Co., Ltd. carries out work environment measurement and other services.
